subject: Fleet Runway: Sprinting to Close – GPU Commit Ask & Contingency
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Sep 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fleet Runway: Sprinting to Close – GPU Commit Ask & Contingency

Team — attaching an updated runway snapshot and a short ask for next steps as ACME moves toward signature. High level:

- Forecasted demand: ACME (pilot -> prod) looks to need ~18 reserved slots sustained for Q4 first 60 days, with occasional burst to 30 slots during onboarding spikes.
- Hardware mix ask: prefer A100s for steady inference and 6 H100-equivalent slots for large model validation + evals.
- Timing: legal indicates MSA sign target 9/28; procurement may need two weeks after that to issue PO. That pushes reserved start to ~10/15 unless we approve earlier commit.

Immediate asks:
1) Infra (Vivek) — can we provision 12 A100 reserved slots and 6 H100-equivalent capacity as a soft-reserve starting 10/01 behind a conditional rollback (no billing until PO)? If not possible, propose alternate timeline.
2) Sales (Ben) — push ACME for a hard MSA signature by 9/28 and confirm pilot start date.
3) Finance (Monica) — confirmation on temporary commit funding to lock burst capacity before PO arrives (we can absorb early provisioning as a credit to the deal if needed).
4) Priyom — update the fleet-runway workbook with the ACME commit scenario (sheet attached).

Attachments: fleet_runway_v2.xlsx (runway with tiered scenarios)

Thanks — I want to lock this plan in the weekly fleet meeting on 9/18.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Sep 2029 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fleet Runway: Sprinting to Close – GPU Commit Ask & Contingency

Sarah — looping you in with the plan Laura shared. Quick summary and MAP attached.

- Goal: pilot initiation in early October, production-ready in November. To guarantee pilot SLAs we recommend a reserved footprint of 12 A100 slots + 6 H100-equivalent slots for the validation window.
- Why reserved? Predictable latency and we can guarantee throughput for your early users. Burst is available but not ideal for onboarding jitter.

Proposed mutual action plan (attached):
- 9/18: finalize scope and pilot target metrics (latency & qps)
- 9/28: MSA signature
- 10/01: soft-reserve provisioning on Redwood side (no billing until PO)
- 10/10: pilot kickoff

Questions for you: can ACME confirm whether H100-class hardware is necessary for the pilot, or can we validate on A100s with a short H100 run for specific evals? If H100s are required, we need to lock earlier.

Attachment: acme_map_20290912.pdf (mutual action plan, 3 pages)

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Sep 2029 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fleet Runway: Sprinting to Close – GPU Commit Ask & Contingency

Thanks Ben — quick answers and a couple of asks from procurement.

- H100s: ACME's ML lead prefers H100 for our large multimodal validation. We can scope the pilot to run most traffic on A100 but request two H100s for a 2-week validation window. If two are enough, that reduces your H100 need from 6 -> 2 for the pilot phase.
- Timing: Procurement needs finalized pricing and a sample SOW by 9/24 to make 9/28 realistic for MSA signature. Is that feasible?
- Compliance: we need a short note on data retention and audit logging for the pilot (SOC2 snippets are fine).

Appreciate the conditional provisioning idea — that would be ideal if you can assign the capacity pending PO.

--
Sarah Cho
Head of Platform, Acme Corp
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Sep 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fleet Runway: Sprinting to Close – GPU Commit Ask & Contingency

Team — quick finance readout on the ask to provision ahead of PO:

- We can authorize up to 30 days of pre-provisioned capacity as a temporary credit for strategic pilot deals (ACME qualifies). This requires a short approval note from Sales to Finance acknowledging chargebacks to the deal if PO slips beyond 30 days.
- I need a cost estimate: per-slot monthly cost for A100 and H100 (include uplift for reserved vs on-demand). If Priyom can add a pricing column to the runway sheet (and include per-slot delta), I can turn this into an approval memo.

Attachment: reserve_pricing_breakdown.csv (sample per-slot pricing)

Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Sep 2029 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fleet Runway: Sprinting to Close – GPU Commit Ask & Contingency

Thanks for the rapid responses — summary and owners ahead of the weekly ops huddle: 

Decision items for 9/18 meeting:
- Infra to confirm whether we can soft-provision 12 A100 + 6 H100-equivalent slots on 10/01 with a rollback and zero billing until PO (Vivek). If not, propose nearest alternative.
- Sales to get SOW + finalized pricing to ACME by 9/24 and push for MSA 9/28 (Ben).
- Finance to prepare 30-day provisional funding memo and finalize per-slot uplift numbers (Monica).
- Priyom to update fleet_runway_v2.xlsx with the ACME-commit scenario and pricing columns; link in the meeting notes.

Contingency plan if H100 capacity is constrained: we will run pilot majority on A100 and schedule a 48–72 hour H100 validation window (CloudScale Ops can spin H100 short runs). Vivek, please confirm whether CloudScale Ops is acceptable as a short-duration H100 fallback and estimated lead time.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/ACME-2029-PE-01), Runway sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FleetRunwayV2)

I'll cover this as the first line item in the fleet sync — see you all on the call.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
